messages:
liyah: Quick thread: proposing an "autofallback summary" line in the console row so oncall can triage fast. Minimal, no PII.

omar: Love that. Suggest format: [SEV] <fallback-mode>   reason_short  est_cost_delta. Example: [WARN] Quiet-degrade · latency_tail · est +9%.

ben: Implementation notes: UI shows only the summary; clicking Inspect opens side panel with policy snippet, metric badges (p95, err%), confidence, and a link to the audited trace. Side panel must not contain request text.

liyah: Telemetry for the summary should be flat keys: decision_id, ts, fallback_mode, trigger_enum, p95_ms, err_pct, sample_pct, confidence_pct, est_cost_pct, org_hash, override_state. Keep snake_case for compatibility.

omar: For privacy, store sha256(prefix) + token_count + redaction_flag in the audit event. Add sampled_snippet_allowed boolean. UI shows "snippet gated" unless user has data-access role.

ben: Operator overrides: soft (default TTL 10m, editable) and hard (requires ticket id + approver). Soft shows countdown next to the summary; hard creates an immutable audit line.

ops-bot: alert: fallback_rate(api-search) > 2% over 5m -> paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

liyah: One more ask: include a tiny fingerprint link in the summary that opens related-decisions by hashed_prefix within +/-15m. Helps spot repeats quickly. We'll document enums and retention (90d default) in the RFC.

omar: I'll prototype the summary string and side panel in figma. ben will own API schema PR. liyah will draft RFC.

ben: Drafted API shape (conceptual single-row, flat): decision_id, ts, fallback_mode, trigger_key, policy, rule_id, p95_ms, err_pct, sample_pct, confidence_pct, est_cost_pct, org_hash, override_by, sampled_snippet_allowed.

liyah: Great. If no objections I'll fold this into a short RFC and attach mocks. Tweak TTL/retention in RFC if needed. :white_check_mark:
